<!--
Read CONTRIBUTING.md before opening a PR. Solve one underlying problem.
Use a conventional commit title in plain language, such as
"fix(addon): pairing link shows the HA address". Scopes: addon, ci, docs, tests, scripts.
-->

## Problem

<!-- Explain the problem in a sentence or two. Include expected behavior and
reproduction steps or environment where relevant. -->

## Change

<!-- Explain how this fixes the problem. If it touches several files (options,
translations, docs, changelog, scripts), say why each is needed for the same fix.
Split independent fixes. -->

## Verification

<!-- Describe the focused checks you ran and the observed results: the script or
test you ran, the container logs, the CI run. State anything you could not check.
"Tests pass" alone is insufficient. For a new or changed workflow, link the run on
a branch. Upload evidence to GitHub; never commit PR-only assets.
Never paste real addresses, pairing codes or tokens. -->

<!-- If you used an agent, end with the model and harness that did the work. -->
